summary: America's Car-Mart (CRMT) filed an 8-K reporting a lender forbearance agreement under its Credit Agreement dated October 30, 2025. On June 1, 2026, Silver Point Finance (Agent) agreed not to exercise remedies through June 8, 2026, extended to June 12, 2026, due to anticipated defaults on minimum liquidity and collateral coverage ratio covenants. No financial terms were disclosed. The board approved a retention program for senior management including CEO and CFO. The forbearance reserves all lender rights post-expiration. Watch for potential covenant waiver negotiations, equity raise, or restructuring risk.
